name: Vacoflux48
variant: 0.35 mm strip, magnetic final anneal (880 C, 10 h, hydrogen)

provenance.source: VAC 'Soft magnetic cobalt-iron alloys VACOFLUX and VACODUR' (edition 2021), docs/sources/materials/vac_cobalt_iron_alloys_vacoflux_vacodur_2021.pdf, p. 8: DC table for 0.35 mm strip after magnetic final annealing (300-16000 A/m); below 300 A/m the nodes of the Figure 1 VACOFLUX 48 curve, read from the PDF vector path with tools/digitise_bh.py. Curve and table agree within 0.6 % at 300, 800 and 1600 A/m. The 16000 A/m point (2.30 T) is dropped: with the 8000 A/m point (2.29 T) its rounded slope is below mu0, and the saturation tail covers it.
provenance.anneal_recipe: 880 C, 10 h, hydrogen, cooling 100-200 K/h (VAC brochure p. 15)

stacking_factor_source: PROVISIONAL: the VAC brochure gives no stacking factor; 0.95 is a placeholder until the supplier states one
saturation_polarisation_source: VAC Vacoflux 48 datasheet (2022) and brochure: Js 2.30 T
